subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The code path is reviewable and has no concrete blocking defect, but the compatibility behavior and overlapping candidate PRs require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix because it covers planner callback, plugin registration wiring, and malformed metadata guards without changing returned tool resolution.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select another open candidate if maintainers prefer a smaller planner-only or descriptor-registration-only implementation, then close this PR after that path lands.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if maintainers want malformed plugin availability to affect tool filtering rather than only emit authoring diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix because it covers planner callback, plugin registration wiring, and malformed metadata guards without changing returned tool resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice centers on plugin descriptor-cache behavior and plugin-facing compatibility, where history points most strongly to this owner candidate.
